VBO:0200127.summary: Basset Griffon Vendéens comprise the Grand and Petit, two French scent-hound breeds developed for hunting on foot. Their separate standards describe distinct proportions as well as different sizes.
VBO:0200127.shortDescription: The Grand and Petit Basset Griffon Vendéens share a French tradition of scent hunting on foot.
